#### AMIND-01 · تصميم ذاكرة الوكيل وتقييمها وتدقيق التسميم · Agent memory design, eval and poisoning audit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تقرير الحاجة لذاكرة للوكيل وتكلفتها وتقييمها وتدقيق خطر التسميم. — Decide whether and how to give an agent memory, cost it, evaluate it and audit for poisoning.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Adding memory to an agent, choosing paradigm, budgeting, or hardening against OWASP ASI06.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Choose paradigm: raw context vs flat vs structured. 2) Map the storage surface: who holds bytes, who executes writes. 3) Budget break-even against a named baseline with caps. 4) Build golden eval set with provenance and judged failure modes. 5) Enumerate write paths for poisoning, add provenance and review gates. **أرقام / params:** agent, baseline

#### AMIND-02 · فرز النهج الوكيلي وتصميم الأدوات وتحصين التقييم · Agentic approach triage, tool design and eval hardening · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقرر هل تحتاج المهمة وكيلًا أصلًا، ويختار البنية والأدوات، ثم يقيّمه ويحصّنه بتسجيل المسار وسقوف الحلقات وواجهات أدوات وCLI صديقة للوكلاء. — Decide whether a task needs an agent at all, pick topology and tools, then evaluate and harden it with trajectory scoring, loop caps and agent-friendly tool or CLI interfaces.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Designing a new agent or LLM feature, asking agent-vs-workflow or single-vs-multi-agent, an agent is unreliable, slow or expensive, or building a CLI that agents call.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Walk the decision tree: agent-vs-workflow gate -> single vs multi-agent -> orchestration topology -> framework. 2) Design tools: unambiguous names, typed parameters, examples inside descriptions, errors that teach recovery, a small tool count. 3) Plan context and memory strategy. 4) Build an offline eval over a fixed task set scoring task completion, trajectory and tool-use correctness (golden datasets, LLM-judge). 5) Harden loops: step and tool-call caps, retries, guardrails. 6) For agent-facing CLIs follow compact, predictable output conventions. **أرقام / params:** task description; candidate frameworks; eval dataset; step cap
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT / Apache-2.0 (1300); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2229-ai-agent-engineering/8465-triage-agentic-approach` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2229-ai-agent-engineering/8463-design-agent-tools-and-context` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2229-ai-agent-engineering/8464-evaluate-and-harden-agent`

#### AMIND-04 · حلقة وكيل محدودة بإنجاز يتحقق منه الجهاز · Bounded agent loop with machine-verified completion · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحوّل هدفًا محددًا إلى خطة مهام قابلة للتحقق وينفذها مهمة مهمة مع فحوص يشغّلها المتحكم وإعادة محاولة بسقف وتصعيد بشري، ولا يُغلق قبل التحقق من كل مهمة أو الإعفاء منها. — Compile a concrete goal into a verifiable task plan, run it task by task with controller-run checks, capped retries and human escalation, and refuse to close until every task is verified or waived.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants an agent or subagent to drive a goal to done unattended, tighten a definition of done because agents claim completion early, or run a long goal as resumable fresh-context iterations.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ask forcing questions first: observable DONE outcome (artifact plus a command that exits 0), no-touch paths, escalation owner, budget (default 12 loop iterations, 3 attempts per task). 2) Compile goal to plan JSON (vague goals are refused). 3) Init state file; loop `next` -> execute one task -> `record` -> `verify`, where the controller itself runs the check command and stores evidence. 4) Never adjudicate your own verification or edit the gate; a retry must change approach. 5) Exhausted budgets escalate (exit 2/5), never fake success; only a human waives. 6) Close is refused while anything is unverified; durable state lets a fresh session resume. **أرقام / params:** goal text; domain manifest; max_attempts_per_task; max_loop_iterations; no-touch paths
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/154-agent-harness/511-agent-harness` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3052-adlc-verify/13152-definition-of-done` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3046-adlc-build/13095-long-running-agent-work`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): agent-harness/agent-harness (#511); adlc-verify/definition-of-done (#13152); adlc-build/long-running-agent-work (#13095) · theme agent-workflow · 6 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/154-agent-harness/511-agent-harness, skills/3052-adlc-verify/13152-definition-of-done, skills/3046-adlc-build/13095-long-running-agent-work

#### AMIND-05 · حلقة محاولات محدودة مع تقرير توقف · Bounded retry loop with stop-report · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحدد سقفا للمحاولات لكل هدف وعند بلوغه يتوقف ويقدم الحالة وفرضيات مرتبة. — Cap attempts per objective and, at the bound, stop and report state with ranked hypotheses instead of trying again.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Re-pushing to fix CI, retrying a flaky repro, 'still failing, try again'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Declare the bound at attempt one (default 3 for externally visible pushes, 5 for local retries). 2) Count every variant as an attempt at the same objective. 3) At the bound, stop. 4) Report current state, what was tried, ranked falsifiable hypotheses, handoff to diagnosis or a fresh session.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2025-stop-rule/7194-stop-rule` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2980-sdd-composy/12612-sdd-loop`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): stop-rule/stop-rule (#7194); sdd-composy/sdd-loop (#12612) · theme agent-workflow · 2 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/2025-stop-rule/7194-stop-rule, skills/2980-sdd-composy/12612-sdd-loop

#### AMIND-06 · حفظ تصحيحات الجلسة في ذاكرة دائمة عبر الجلسات · Capture session corrections into persistent memory · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** التقاط التصحيحات والدروس الدائمة أثناء الجلسة ثم تخزينها وإعادة تحميلها (تحديث CLAUDE.md أو ملفات ذاكرة محلية أو خدمة ذاكرة مستضافة) لتبدأ الجلسات اللاحقة بسياق جاهز. — Capture corrections and durable insights during a session, then store and reload them (CLAUDE.md updates through a reflect step, local memory files, or a hosted memory service) so later sessions start informed.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User says 'remember this', corrects the same thing twice, a session starts or resumes after compaction, or project knowledge must outlive the chat.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Detect learning signals in-session (explicit corrections, repeated preferences, decisions). 2) Queue them and remind the user to run a reflect step rather than silently rewriting instructions. 3) On approval write durable items to CLAUDE.md or a project memory directory, one fact per entry, dated. 4) At session start or resume, load or search stored memory (local files, or a hosted librarian when a key is configured). 5) Sync incrementally from the last checkpoint so repeated runs are cheap. 6) Periodically classify entries as delete, merge, shorten or keep, and back up before pruning. Procedure inferred from descriptions, not from the scripts. **أرقام / params:** storage target (CLAUDE.md|memory dir|hosted service); approval mode; checkpoint scope
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1070-claude-reflect/2374-claude-reflect` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1637-claude-never-forgets/4621-memory` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3614-centricmem-skill/14545-centricmem-agent`

#### AMIND-07 · مراسلة وكلاء مشاريع أخرى عبر الألواح · Cross-project agent messaging via terminal panes · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يسلّم مهمة أو يسأل وكيلاً في مشروع آخر ويبلّغ أي وكيل تم الوصول إليه. — Hands a job to, or asks a question of, an agent running in another project's workspace and reports which agent was reached.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Work belongs to a different repo or session in a multiplexed agent workspace.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run the tell/ask command directly with a project fragment and the task. 2) Fragment is matched against workspace, tab, name, pane and cwd. 3) On ambiguity, show candidates and let the user choose; never guess. 4) Fall back to a registry or zoxide path to spawn a workspace. 5) Confirm destructive requests first. 6) Tell is fire-and-forget; use ask for answers.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1454-herdr/3554-tell` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1454-herdr/3550-ask` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/(see batch file path field)`

#### AMIND-08 · سجل حالة المهام عبر الجلسات · Cross-session task-state journal · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحتفظ بسجل ذاتي التجاهل داخل المستودع لمواقع المهام الحية ليبقى بعد الضغط أو المسح. — Keep an in-repo self-ignoring journal of live threads (worktree, branch, PR) so state survives compaction and /clear.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Starting, closing or switching a task, creating a worktree, opening a PR, or before compaction.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Init docs/session-journal/ with a '*' .gitignore. 2) Maintain _active.md as the cross-session index of unclosed threads with where each lives. 3) Per-session directory holds _detail.md and drafts. 4) Keep a bounded compression block: decisions, open questions, user direction, focus, next action. 5) Reconcile against reality at session start.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2057-session-journal/7302-session-journal` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1540-session-handoff/4223-session-handoff`

#### AMIND-09 · قرار التفويض للوكلاء أو التنفيذ المباشر · Delegate-or-inline decision for subagents · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقرر هل المهمة تستحق وكيلا فرعيا ويقسمها إلى وحدات مستقلة بعقد إخراج واضح. — Decide whether a task earns a subagent round trip and split it into independent units with explicit return contracts.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Large multi-step task, 'fan this out', 'orchestrate this'.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Do cheap discovery inline. 2) Delegate only if output is large and only the conclusion matters, or 2+ units are truly independent and work exceeds a few tool calls. 3) Keep dependent chains inline. 4) One answerable question per agent with a stated return shape (file:line table, verdict plus why). 5) Bound each delegation so it cannot hang.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1408-toolu/3345-orchestrator` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2679-superpowers/10256-dispatching-parallel-agents`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): toolu/orchestrator (#3345); superpowers/dispatching-parallel-agents (#10256) · theme agent-workflow · 6 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/1408-toolu/3345-orchestrator, skills/2679-superpowers/10256-dispatching-parallel-agents

#### AMIND-10 · نقطة حفظ مدعومة بالأدلة لاستئناف المهمة · Evidence-based checkpoint manifest for resume · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يسجل تقدم مهمة طويلة في ملف JSON موثّق ليُستأنف العمل بعد إعادة ضبط السياق. — Records bounded progress inside a long task as a validated JSON manifest so work resumes after a context reset.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** A phase or commit lands, context is about to compact, or the session is degrading.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Collect git branch, HEAD sha and status. 2) Write a checkpoint JSON: task, steps_completed each with evidence (sha, test output), current_outputs, pending_steps, resume.next_operation as a literal first action. 3) Hash the dirty diff when tree is dirty. 4) Quote sha strings so they stay strings. 5) Validate against the schema before trusting it. 6) Steps without evidence move to pending.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/342-kernel/1216-checkpoint` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/342-kernel/1228-ingest`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas mining 2026-10-20 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas): kernel/checkpoint (#1216); kernel/ingest (#1228) · theme agent-workflow · 5 supporting skills · verifier read: skills/342-kernel/1216-checkpoint, skills/342-kernel/1228-ingest

#### AMIND-11 · تنفيذ الخطط بوكلاء مسمّين وسجل تقدم دائم · Execute plans with named agents and progress ledger · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تنفيذ خطة مكتوبة بالعمل المباشر افتراضياً واستدعاء وكلاء مسمّين معرّفين مسبقاً فقط في موجات متوازية بعد فحص السلامة، مع سجل تقدم مرتبط بـgit يسمح بالاستئناف بعد الضغط. — Run a written plan by implementing directly by default and spawning only predefined named agents in safety-checked parallel waves, while a git-backed progress ledger lets the work resume after compaction.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Large plan with independent tasks; fan-out of two or more independent jobs; resuming an interrupted plan; deciding whether delegation is worth it; requests to parallelize or orchestrate.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Load the plan, map task dependencies, list the unblocked tasks. 2) Before any spawn answer four questions: why can't I do it myself, which named agent fits, is it independent enough, what exactly do I pass. 3) Use only predefined agents (explorer, researcher, planner, coder); never fake a subagent by injecting a prompt at call time. 4) Group unblocked tasks that clear a safety checklist (no shared files, no dependencies) into one wave and dispatch it in a single message. 5) Read results and integrate; you own coherence. 6) Append '- [x] Task N: name - commits base..head, review clean' to a ledger file per feature; after compaction trust ledger plus git log over recollection. **أرقام / params:** plan file path; agent roster; wave size; ledger path (.condux/progress/<slug>.md style)
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`git`](../requirements.md#req-git) · [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1534-condux/4212-subagent-execution` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1534-condux/4211-subagent-deployment` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2875-codex-howto/11595-orchestrate-engineering`

#### AMIND-12 · نقل نتائج الوكلاء بأمانة · Faithful relay of agent results · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ينقل مخرجات الوكلاء مع حفظ الأعداد الدقيقة وأسباب الفشل والنطاق ومراجع الملفات. — Pass agent output onward keeping exact counts, failure reasons, scope and artifact references intact.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Receiving worker output or handing it to another actor or the user.

#### AMIND-13 · بروتوكول صندوق وارد وتحكم بالملفات بين الوكلاء · File-based multi-agent inbox and control protocol · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ينسق الوكلاء عبر ملف تشغيل وصندوق وارد وملفات حالة وأوامر إيقاف/إلغاء/إعادة توجيه. — Coordinates agents through a run file, per-agent inbox, status files and pause/cancel/redirect directives.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** An active multi-agent run needs dependency waiting, status dashboard or user intervention.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Resolve a harness dir outside the project. 2) Read run.json; stop if no active run. 3) Read own inbox.jsonl. 4) Check control.json for pause, cancel, redirect, resume addressed to self or all, then bump generation to ack. 5) Wait until dependencies' status is DONE. 6) Finish with DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, BLOCKED or NEEDS_CONTEXT.

#### AMIND-15 · إبقاء الأسرار خارج سجلات الوكلاء · Keep credentials out of agent transcripts · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يتعامل مع الأسرار دون تسريبها إلى السجلات أو الأوامر مع إثبات التدوير ببصمة. — Handle secrets without echoing them into transcripts, argv, summaries or allowlists, proving rotation by fingerprint.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Fetching, rotating or installing a token, or a command takes a credential.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pass secrets via environment variables or files, never in the command string. 2) Never narrate or paste values. 3) Compare using a fingerprint (hash prefix) or ask the service. 4) Redirect large outputs so spills hold no secret. 5) Avoid approving allowlist entries containing values.

#### AMIND-16 · تشخيص ذاتي لكسر الحلقات وانضباط التحقق · Loop-break self-diagnosis and verification discipline · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يطبق بروتوكولات تصحيح قصيرة عند التكرار أو السياق القديم أو رسالة لم تصل. — Applies short corrective protocols when an agent loops, acts on stale context or sends a message that did not land.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Three or more consecutive failures, circular retries, stale or contradicted context, unclear previous reply.
- **كيف / how:** 1) After 3 failures stop and diagnose rather than retry. 2) Challenge context that may be stale or weakly sourced before acting. 3) Re-pitch an unclear message with missing context. 4) Run review-resolve loops until findings converge. 5) Batch correctors in one forked pass.

#### AMIND-17 · توضيح الرسائل المعقدة قرارًا قرارًا · One-decision-at-a-time clarification of dense messages · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعيد صياغة رسالة كثيفة أو مجموعة أسئلة بحيث يُعرض قرار واحد في كل مرة مع تعريف المصطلحات وإجابة مقترحة وتحديد ما يجب على القارئ حسمه. — Rewrite a dense, decision-heavy message or question set as one decision at a time with defined jargon, a recommended answer and the exact thing the reader must decide.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User says the questions were unclear, too many, a wall of text or too technical; asks for ADHD-friendly short numbered steps; or a task rests on assumptions the agent should surface.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Chunk the message so each chunk holds one decision. 2) Define the session's own jargon on first use and quote operative terms verbatim. 3) State exactly what the reader must decide and give a recommended default. 4) Ask one question per turn in plain language. 5) Before asking, collect everything reachable from files and tools; hand back only the unreachable as the user's unknown. 6) Prefer short numbered steps and a sober register without emoji or hype when requested. **أرقام / params:** message text; output style (ADHD-short, scholarly)

#### AMIND-18 · إطلاق وكلاء متوازين لكل مجال فشل مستقل · Parallel agent dispatch per independent failure domain · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يجمع الأعطال حسب المجال المستقل ويطلق وكيلا معزولا لكل مجال ثم يدمج النتائج. — Group failures by independent domain and dispatch one isolated-context agent per domain, then integrate results.

#### AMIND-20 · مراسلة مباشرة بين جلسات Claude Code العاملة · Peer messaging between running Claude Code sessions · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** استشارة جلسة Claude Code تعمل بالفعل أو تفويضها باستخدام ListAgents وSendMessage مع العنونة الصحيحة وأشكال الاستدعاء ومعالجة الردود وإظهار الحركة للإنسان، بدل claude -p أو قراءة الطرفية. — Consult or delegate to an already-running Claude Code session with ListAgents and SendMessage using correct addressing, call shapes, reply handling and human-visible traffic, instead of headless claude -p or terminal scraping.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** You need a fact, answer or unit of work from an open session; a delegated agent has gone silent; waiting without polling; Claude and Codex agents must talk as peers; a human wants to see who is asking whom.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Check the Claude Code version supports native messaging (>=2.1.224). 2) ListAgents; the name shown is the address; send the bare name and add [ref] only to disambiguate, never a stale ref. 3) Pick a shape: quick question (peer answers with its own SendMessage), work order (ask to be notified when idle, then read the result), conference (multi-turn; reply using the sender attribute of the inbound wrapper). 4) Cloud peers receive but cannot reply, so read their transcript. 5) Never invent a peer's answer if it refuses. 6) Name sessions consistently across ListAgents, Remote Control and tab title; log a message envelope for visibility. 7) Codex lacks these tools; bridge via panes. **أرقام / params:** peer name; call shape (question|work order|conference); notify-when-idle flag
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`chromium`](../requirements.md#req-chromium)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0 / MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### AMIND-21 · شجرة قرار حدود المراحل والتسليم بين الجلسات · Phase-boundary tree: continue, clear, handoff, delegate, compact · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** المرور على شجرة قرار مرتبة من خمسة فروع عند نهاية كل مرحلة لاختيار المتابعة أو المسح أو التسليم أو التفويض أو الضغط، وكتابة ملف تسليم يشير إلى المواصفات والخطط والقرارات بمسارها لا بنسخها. — Walk an ordered five-branch decision tree at each finished phase to choose between continuing, clearing, handing off, delegating or compacting, and write handoff files that point to specs, plans, ADRs, issues and diffs by path or URL instead of copying them.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Context window filling up; unsure whether to clear or compact; moving work to another harness, directory, worktree or colleague; a /handoff request; resuming from a continuity file; caching hard-won research before it is lost.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Gate: only at a real phase boundary (last output settled, next phase not started); mid-phase just continue or push remaining work to a subagent. 2) Walk top-down, first match wins: CONTINUE if the next phase needs current context and the window is still in its quality zone; CLEAR only if everything is positively confirmed disposable; HANDOFF only if you can name what crosses which boundary (harness, directory, person, parallel fork); DELEGATE if the rest is bounded enough to run unattended; else COMPACT. 3) Handoff file: present tense, agent-facing, resumable, references by path or URL, never inline copies. 4) Check links resolve and run a secret scan before it leaves the machine. **أرقام / params:** boundary type (harness|directory|person|fork); target agent; where to store the handoff file
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`claude:tools`](../requirements.md#req-claude-tools)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0 / MIT (no copyleft seen among supporting ids); the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2008-context-handoff/7173-context-handoff` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1391-compound-engineering/3290-ce-handoff` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2992-development-skills/12689-handoff`

#### AMIND-24 · استرجاع نتائج الوكيل الصامت قبل إعادة إطلاقه · Recover silent subagent results before respawning · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يميز الوكيل المنتهي الصامت من المعلق عبر سجله ويسترجع عمله دون إعادة التشغيل. — Tell a finished-but-mute subagent from a wedged one using its transcript and recover its work without rerunning.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Agents go idle with no findings, ListAgents shows them alive, or you are about to kill and respawn.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ignore idle notices (runtime-generated). 2) Inspect transcript: a tool_use with no tool_result means truly blocked; none means not wedged. 3) Check whether the agent type lacks a messaging tool or is a forward-only wrapper. 4) Recover output from transcript or the job runtime state directory. 5) Next time choose an agent type with a reporting channel.

#### AMIND-25 · عقد مسار عمل للوكيل بحدود نطاق صارمة · Scope-fenced worker lane contract · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحدد لكل وكيل مولَّد المخرج والملفات المسموحة والفخاخ وأوامر التحقق والمحظورات وصيغة الإرجاع. — Defines every spawned agent lane with deliverable, allowed files, traps, exact verify commands, forbidden actions and raw-data return.

#### AMIND-26 · نقطة حفظ وتسليم بين الجلسات عبر مجلد .context · Session checkpoint and handoff via a .context store · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يلخّص الحالة المهمة قبل ضغط السياق أو الخروج في نقطة حفظ وتسليم دائمة، فتبدأ الجلسة أو الوكيل التالي بتوجيه جاهز بدل بداية باردة. — Distill the high-signal state before a context compaction or exit into a durable checkpoint and handoff, so the next session, agent or CLI window resumes with orientation instead of a cold start.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User says checkpoint, save context before compact/clear, wrap up, close out, hand off, resume work, or a long multi-step task risks losing state across resets.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Compact mode: before compaction write a dated checkpoint distilling decisions, open questions, file/branch state and the next step since the last checkpoint. 2) Handoff mode: add what the next agent must read first and known gotchas. 3) Keep a shared store (e.g. `.context/` with a routing table saying when to read each file) so any CLI or model can pick up the work. 4) Session start: read the latest checkpoint, present project state, then ask what to work on. 5) Close-out ritual: commit, export the conversation, write the handoff, harvest durable lessons into memory. **أرقام / params:** mode: compact | handoff | close-out; store directory

#### AMIND-36 · استئناف سير عمل متوقف بالتحقق أولاً · Verify-first workflow resume from sidecar state · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يستأنف تشغيلاً متوقفاً بتحميل الحالة الجانبية والتحقق من آخر خطوة قبل المتابعة. — Resumes an interrupted workflow run by loading sidecar state and re-verifying the last step before continuing.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** A crash, pause or blocked run needs continuing, or checkboxes may have drifted from reality.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Resolve the run: explicit run id, else match by workflow file; if several match list them and ask, never pick silently. 2) Load the JSON sidecar (run id, status, current_step, per-step status and attempts, last verify output) as source of truth. 3) Re-run the verify of the in-progress step; if it passes mark done. 4) Else retry within the iteration limit. 5) Treat any reconcile tool output as advisory.

#### AMIND-45 · تطوير قائم على الشك: مراجعة عدائية للقرارات غير البديهية · Doubt-driven development for non-trivial decisions · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يخضع كل قرار غير بديهي لمراجعة عدائية بسياق جديد قبل اعتماده، ولا يطبقها على الأعمال الآلية. — Cross-examines each non-trivial decision with a fresh-context adversarial review before it stands, and skips mechanical work.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تأكد من القرار، راجع افتراضاتك، هل هذا آمن فعلاً / challenge this decision, adversarial review, is this really safe
- **كيف / how:** 1) A decision is non-trivial when it adds or changes branching, crosses a module or service boundary, asserts what the compiler cannot check (thread safety, idempotence, ordering), depends on context a future reader cannot see, or is irreversible (deploy, migration, public API). 2) For those, state the claim, then have an independent reviewer with no shared context try to break it. 3) Not for renames, formatting, file moves, clear instructions, summaries or one-line obvious fixes, or when the user asked for speed. 4) Doubting every keystroke ships nothing; the gate applies only to the list above. **أرقام / params:** non-trivial criteria

- **ماذا / what:** شريك تفكير منظم يبني الخطة ويهاجمها في الوقت نفسه، ويعامل كل ادعاء كفرضية حتى يثبت. — A structured thinking partner that builds the plan and attacks it at the same time, treating every claim as a hypothesis until it earns its place.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** خطط معي بجدية، انقد فكرتي، عصف ذهني صارم / rigorous planning, critique my idea, structured brainstorming
- **كيف / how:** 1) No empathic filler ('great idea'); acknowledge facts and move on. 2) Every significant premise is a hypothesis: list load-bearing assumptions and test each. 3) Collaborator and devil's advocate run in parallel, not in turns. 4) Externalise the reasoning chain: inferences, assumptions, uncertainty. 5) Do not converge early; compare competing hypotheses against the evidence and keep the one with least disconfirming evidence. 6) Output a plan that survived scrutiny, with its failure modes named. **أرقام / params:** assumptions list
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`pip:hypothesis`](../requirements.md#req-pip-hypothesis)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3243-heuer-planning/13679-heuer-planning`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): heuer-planning/heuer-planning (#13679) · theme planning-specs · 1 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/3243-heuer-planning/13679-heuer-planning

#### AMIND-47 · استخراج المتطلبات: اسأل ولا تخترع · Requirements elicitation: elicit, do not invent · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقرأ وثيقة منتج ويستخرج ما ينقصها بأسئلة موجهة لكل طرف، دون أن يملأ الفراغات بافتراضات تقنية. — Reads a product document and surfaces what is missing as targeted questions per stakeholder, without filling gaps with invented technical detail.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** حلّل الـ PRD، ما الناقص في المواصفات، متطلبات تقنية / analyse PRD, missing requirements, spec gaps
- **كيف / how:** 1) Point out ambiguous or underspecified statements, quoting the source line. 2) Turn each gap into a specific question grouped by stakeholder (product, design, engineering, legal). 3) Rate the technical risk each gap creates. 4) Never invent stack, architecture or data models the document does not state, and never add scope. 5) Rank risky assumptions on an impact x risk matrix and propose a cheap experiment for the top ones. **أرقام / params:** stakeholders
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3395-requirements-elicitation/13931-requirements-elicitation`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): requirements-elicitation/requirements-elicitation (#13931) · theme planning-specs · 3 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/3395-requirements-elicitation/13931-requirements-elicitation

#### AMIND-48 · توجيه إلى أخصائي واحد مع إلزام القراءة · Route to one specialist, read before answering · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يوجّه المسألة الهندسية إلى أخصائي واحد مناسب ويقرأ ملفه قبل أي إجابة؛ تحميل أخصائيين كثر يعني أن التوجيه فشل. — Routes an engineering question to one fitting specialist and reads its file before answering; loading many specialists means routing failed.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** أي خبير يناسب المسألة، توجيه المهمة / pick the right specialist, route the task
- **كيف / how:** 1) Classify the request (architecture, reliability, security, data, rollout...) and pick the single best specialist. 2) Read its reference completely before giving guidance; an answer from priors without the read does not count. 3) Load a second specialist only for a named sub-decision. 4) This mirrors KOSIF's own rule: brief and hub first, then the smallest set of powers. **أرقام / params:** one specialist
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### AMIND-50 · تحديث خارطة الطريق من الأدلة مع ذكر وضع الفحص · Evidence-based roadmap update with an explicit scan mode · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحدّث ملف خارطة الطريق بحسب ما في الكود فعلاً، ويصرّح هل فحص المستودع كاملاً أم اعتمد على سياق الجلسة. — Updates the roadmap file from what the code actually shows and states whether it did a full scan or relied on session context.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** حدّث خارطة الطريق، ما الذي أنجز فعلاً / update roadmap, what is actually done
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ask once: full scan or short-circuit from evidence already in the session. 2) Locate ROADMAP.md in a fixed search order. 3) Mark a task done only with evidence (file, commit, test); otherwise leave it open. 4) In short-circuit mode prefix each status line with its source ([SC] from context, [SC->FS] fallback scan) so 'not scanned because known' differs from 'forgot to scan'. 5) The report states MODE explicitly. **أرقام / params:** scan mode

## التصحيح — Debugging & diagnosis

#### AMIND-39 · قاطع التكرار العقيم بعد محاولتين فاشلتين · Anti-thrashing circuit breaker after two failed fixes · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** توقف عن التعديل بعد المحاولة الثانية الفاشلة لنفس الأسلوب وأعد التتبع من منشأ الخطأ. — Stop editing after the second failed attempt of the same approach and re-trace from the source of the fault.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Catching yourself re-running with tweaked values; user says going in circles.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Count attempts per problem; fire on 2nd failure of same approach. 2) Write the assumed theory down. 3) Gather evidence: log at source, debugger, git bisect, diff working vs broken. 4) Trace where the bad value is born, not where it lands. 5) New stated hypothesis before next edit. 6) Escalate with a ruled-out list instead of a silent fourth try. **أرقام / params:** intensity lite|full|ultra
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1068-bullpen/2372-stop-digging` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1457-aegis/3573-systematic-debugging`

## DevOps والسحابة — DevOps, CI/CD, cloud & infrastructure

#### AMIND-40 · إثبات التراجع قبل أي إجراء لا رجعة فيه · Prove rollback before irreversible action · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يشترط مسار استعادة مسمى ومجرّبا قبل الحذف أو الدفع القسري أو الترحيل أو الإزالة. — Requires a named, rehearsed restore path (restore to scratch, diff, dry-run) before deletes, force-pushes, migrations or teardowns.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Before drop/delete/force-push/terraform destroy/migration; phrases like prove the rollback.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Name one executable restore path (not 'we have backups'). 2) Exercise it now: restore to scratch and diff, or verify integrity, or dry-run. 3) Record evidence in session. 4) Only then run the action. Human sign-off does not replace the rehearsal.

#### AMIND-42 · مراجعة الافتراضات وإعادة التقييم · Challenge approach before commitment · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يختبر الافتراضات ويعيد التقييم عند تعثر المنهج. — Stress assumptions, opportunity cost and alternatives, or reset when the current approach fails.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Preferred approach about to be committed, or user says it is wrong.
- **كيف / how:** 1) State the preferred approach and its assumptions. 2) Test opportunity costs and uncertainty. 3) List alternatives. 4) On 'wrong', stop, restate the goal, re-evaluate. 5) Re-pitch unclear messages plainly.

#### AMIND-43 · قسم الملاحظات والحالة الختامي · Closing Caveats and status section · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يختم تقرير الإنجاز بما تم التحقق منه وما افترض وما لم يغطَّ. — End any nontrivial completion report with Verified / Assumed / Not covered lines backed by commands actually run.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** About to report a task as done, fixed or passing.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run verification and read real output first. 2) Write a 'Caveats & status' block. 3) Verified: only commands run or behavior observed this session, with result. 4) Assumed: taken on faith. 5) Not covered: out of scope or unverifiable, stated explicitly. 6) Report failures with actual error text; omit empty lines; skip for trivial Q&A.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### AMIND-49 · أعد الاستخدام أو استبدل علناً: لا طريقتين لشيء واحد · Reuse or openly replace: one way to do a thing · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إذا وُجدت طريقة معتمدة لفعل شيء، يعيد العمل الجديد استخدامها أو يستبدلها صراحة، ولا يضيف طريقة موازية صامتة. — When an established way exists, new work reuses it or openly replaces it, never adds a silent parallel one.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** لا تكرر الكود، أداة جديدة بجانب القديمة / duplicate implementation, parallel helper, fragmentation
- **كيف / how:** 1) Before adding a helper, script, format or process, search for the existing one. 2) Reuse it, or replace it and migrate callers in the same change, saying so. 3) Two coexisting ways split the reader's model, double the drift surface and tax every future change with 'which one?'. 4) If the project states its own one-way rule, follow that first. 5) When caught mid-work: re-anchor, audit what is in flight, correct forward, report.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2431-discipline/9423-reuse-or-replace`

## التعليم والتعلم — Teaching, learning & study

#### AMIND-44 · تحقق خصومي أعمى من البراهين · Blind adversarial verification of proofs · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يتحقق من براهين المسابقات بمدقق في سياق جديد وثقة معايرة. — Verify olympiad-level proofs with a fresh-context verifier and calibrated confidence.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Solving or checking IMO/Putnam-style problems.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Solve by reasoning only. 2) Strip thinking, pass only the cleaned proof to a fresh verifier. 3) Check red flags: does it imply an open problem; try 2x2 counterexamples. 4) Same gap twice means restructure. 5) Say no confident solution rather than bluff. 6) Optional LaTeX PDF.
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`latex`](../requirements.md#req-latex)
